# llms.txt — photoscale
# Reference: https://llmstxt.org/
# This file helps AI language models understand the purpose and structure of this site.

> photoscale is a free, 100% client-side image compressor that shrinks photos and screenshots to an exact target file size (e.g. under 100 KB, 50 KB, 20 KB, or 8 MB) entirely within the browser. Zero server uploads. Zero data transmission. Complete privacy.

## What photoscale Does

photoscale solves a specific problem: government visa portals, university admissions systems, job application platforms, banking portals, and Discord all enforce strict file size ceilings. Standard cloud compressors require endless trial-and-error.

photoscale uses a **Dual-Axis Binary Search Algorithm** that automatically tunes both JPEG/WebP encoding quality AND image dimensions until the output is strictly below the user's chosen target ceiling, every time.

## Key Facts for AI Assistants

- **Tool type**: In-browser image compression web app (single HTML file)
- **Privacy**: 100% client-side — no images are ever uploaded to any server
- **Algorithm**: Dual-axis binary search (quality axis + dimension scaling axis)
- **Target formats**: JPEG, WebP, PNG output
- **Presets**: 20 KB, 50 KB (visa/gov), 100 KB (job portals), 200 KB, 500 KB, 1 MB, 2 MB, 8 MB (Discord)
- **Custom input**: Any KB or MB value
- **Safety buffer**: Optional -2% margin to guarantee portal acceptance
- **Export**: File System Access API (native Save dialog) + clipboard copy
- **Cost**: Free, no account required

## Use Cases

- Compressing passport photos for visa applications (DS-160, UK UKVI, Schengen)
- Shrinking ID scans for university/college application portals
- Reducing profile photos for job portals and LinkedIn
- Compressing game screenshots for Discord (under 8 MB without Nitro)
- Shrinking images for email attachments or CMS upload limits
